risks.risk: Brand/model may not be Singer (or may be a different make), which affects value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the machine nameplate/brand plate and model number (front of head and side plate).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic fairly used manual sewing machine (not confirmed Singer).

risks.risk: “Working perfectly” may be false (may need servicing: timing, feed, tension, needle bar, belt/treadle action).
risks.proof: Short video of the machine running and sewing a few lines on fabric (showing feed, tension, and stitch formation).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs service).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (flat plate, bobbins, needles, presser feet, attachments) or incomplete set.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included accessory with counts (bobbin case, bobbins, presser feet, needles, flat plate, etc.).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in the photo (rust, bent parts, worn gears, cracked bed, loose stand).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: needle area, feed dogs, underside/belt area, and any rust spots; plus a photo of the stand stability.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fairly used with possible wear (worst case within 'fairly used').

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the brand/model nameplate (and any serial/model number) on the machine head (not just the stand).
Video proof: machine running and sewing on fabric for 1–2 minutes (show feed + stitch result).
Photos of all accessories laid out with counts (flat plate, bobbins, presser feet/attachments, needles, etc.).
Close-ups of the needle/feed area and any rust/wear points (including underside/belt/treadle mechanism).
response.reason: The photo doesn’t show a readable Singer/model identity and there’s no working demonstration or accessory proof, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently from the provided evidence.
